confidence_notes: Holistic estimates; food anchors are better bounded than room rates, which vary widely by property and July demand. The inexpensive meal reflects a modest restaurant rather than a hawker stall. Cocktail and wine estimates use Singapore bar pricing relative to beer.
comparable_city_reasoning: Singapore is a high-cost regional hub, so its restaurant and accommodation anchors sit above typical Southeast Asian city levels; hawker dining remains cheaper than the modest-restaurant anchor.
